segments.narration: The demo starts from frozen toy audit artifacts and asks Glassbox to render a signed Intervention Audit Card.
segments.title: Glassbox certify in 90 seconds

segments.narration: The certifier reads the model identity, corpus hash, protocol counts, and frozen evidence before it scores any rung.
segments.terminal:
model: glassbox-toy-refusal
behavior: refusal
evidence class: synthetic_fixture
records: 48
splits: train=16, validation=16, test=16
corpus hash: 6abcd7beb29ee8c2...
segments.title: Inputs are fixed before certification

segments.narration: The command prints the artifact directory, certified method, output paths, verdict, and card signature.
segments.title: The CLI emits a compact machine-readable verdict

segments.narration: The demo card fails because the SAE feature ablation does not pass held-out causal effect or matched controls.
segments.terminal:
certified method: sae_feature_ablation
overall passed: False

  separation: PASS
  held-out causal: FAIL
  specificity: PASS
  capability cost: PASS
  matched controls: FAIL
segments.title: Each required rung gets an explicit pass or fail

segments.narration: Glassbox writes a JSON contract for tooling, an HTML card for review, a PDF snapshot, and a digest tied to the demo ref.
segments.terminal:
JSON: results/certification/toy-certify-demo.card.json
HTML: docs/demo/certify-demo.card.html
PDF:  results/certification/toy-certify-demo.card.pdf
stdout: docs/demo/certify-demo.stdout.txt
digest: 70c35957cd21d3b77fccb0cd...
segments.title: The card is rendered for humans and automation

segments.narration: The useful part is the discipline: every acceptance or rejection is linked back to frozen files and hashes.
segments.terminal:
Certification is not a rubber stamp.
A weak intervention fails loudly.
The artifacts are deterministic and reviewable.

Open: docs/demo/certify-demo.card.html
segments.title: Takeaway
